Existing proxy/intro presentation is not an approved articulated state export; written regional canon constrains the eventual asset.
support_layer_policy: One combined foreground PNG includes primary AND support/paired fingers; split support layer only if combined order cannot work. Split is an alternate delivery, not another required-file count.
pose_blueprint: Actual committed attack/release: weight moves toward target, body/arms drive weapon or charge, contact remains believable. Bow rear fingers visibly OPEN, string released and arrow no longer nocked. Paired strike alternates hands with second blade present.

attack_anchors.null_rule: Set physically absent/non-applicable anchors to null with an explicit reason; do not invent limbs/emitters
attack_anchors.phase_rule: Named windup/commit/recovery must retain the SAME attack identity and baseline; phase transition/vulnerability distinct from damage recoil

attack_pose_direction: Windup establishes named attack source/limb, commit visibly discharges or contacts along target direction, recovery settles SAME motion. Mouth breath/vent emitter, claw/bite contact, tail/chain sweep arc or hammer/piston/anchor downward contact must correspond to named source anatomy. Do not change timings or infer a new weapon from attack label.

required_body_pose: Exact named CHAIN SWEEP recovery state of this established entity; follow its existing route/attack clocks without redesign.
anatomy_requirements: Complete head/ears, torso/hips, source-authored limbs, feet/tail and relevant hands; palms/grips must not be obscured by charge, trails, sheet text or another pose. Do not reconstruct covered anatomy. Match this entity's anatomy only; non-humanoids do not gain hands/feet. Floating entities retain their hover treatment.

Scoped owner-approved panel is an upper-body workstation vignette with counter/background, not transparent complete anatomy. Superseded beta body/portrait may not fill this request. Existing proxy/intro presentation is not an approved articulated state export; written regional canon constrains the eventual asset.
support_layer_policy: One combined foreground PNG includes primary AND support/paired fingers; split support layer only if combined order cannot work. Split is an alternate delivery, not another required-file count.
pose_blueprint: Same NPC in actual route/walk step, carrying only canonical activity props; contact foot at baseline, lifted foot complete.

required_body_pose: Exact named sit state of this established entity; follow its existing route/attack clocks without redesign.

Do not reconstruct covered anatomy. Match this entity's anatomy only; non-humanoids do not gain hands/feet. Floating entities retain their hover treatment.
